findings.summary: The current eight-tab official menu union contains 75 unique in-scope products. Thirty-six frozen rows remain current, including one normalized name; six are stale.
All four required allergen searches completed. Dedicated gluten-free accommodation menus exist, but no comprehensive allergen matrix or cross-contact policy was found.
